The Abra Lighting Electron 50148ODW brings a clean, architectural presence to residential and commercial exterior walls. Its elongated 14-inch form is paired with a mitered glass diffuser, creating a balanced design that feels modern without appearing overly decorative.

The glass surface helps distribute illumination more evenly while concealing the internal light source. When illuminated, the fixture can add both practical visibility and a refined decorative accent around entrances, patios, walkways, and other exterior areas.

The Electron wall sconce can be installed as a single fixture beside a secondary door or repeated in pairs around a main entrance. Multiple units may also be arranged along exterior corridors or building façades to create a consistent architectural lighting scheme.

Its simple geometry makes it suitable for contemporary, minimalist, and transitional properties. The fixture’s narrow vertical format also works well in areas where horizontal wall space is limited.

The mitered glass diffuser helps create a more comfortable visual effect by softening the appearance of the internal light source. This makes the fixture suitable for exterior areas where both functional illumination and decorative presentation are important.

column2: Nuvo 62-2404 Kenzo Chandelier Bronze
column3:
The Nuvo 62-2404 Kenzo is a 12-light integrated LED chandelier that turns edge-lit acrylic panels into floating ribbons of warm light. Finished in polished anodized bronze, it delivers 6,800 lumens of dimmable 3000K illumination from a slim, sculptural frame — no bulbs to buy, no bulbs to replace.

  • 12 edge-lit LED light guide panels with a soft, glare-free glow
  • 6,800 lumens at warm 3000K — bright enough for dining rooms and open foyers
  • High 90 CRI for accurate, natural color rendering
  • Fully dimmable with standard LED-rated dimmers
  • Polished anodized bronze finish on an aluminum and steel frame
  • cETLus listed, backed by a 3-year manufacturer warranty

Product Overview & Key Applications

Part of Satco's Kenzo collection, the 62-2404 pairs bold geometric styling with genuinely practical light output. Twelve parallel acrylic panels are edge-lit by integrated LEDs, so the light appears to emanate from within the material itself — a clean, modern effect that reads as sculpture when the fixture is off and as ambient art when it's on. At 34.25 inches across and just 5.5 inches tall, it covers a generous footprint without visually crowding the ceiling, making it a strong fit for rooms where you want presence without bulk.

Ideal For

  • Dining rooms and breakfast areas that need warm, even light over a large table
  • Open-concept living spaces and great rooms with standard or raised ceilings
  • Entryways and foyers where a statement fixture sets the tone
  • Hotel lobbies, restaurant dining areas, and boutique retail interiors (dry locations)
  • Primary bedrooms and stairwell landings that call for low-profile drama

Key Performance Benefits

  • Integrated LED efficiency: 6,800 lumens from just 85 watts — roughly the output of a dozen 60W incandescent bulbs at a fraction of the energy cost.
  • Long service life: rated for 30,000 hours, which works out to more than 20 years at four hours of use per day.
  • Comfortable light quality: 3000K warm white with 90 CRI, so skin tones, wood grain, and fabrics look the way they should.
  • Wide 120° beam spread: panels distribute light broadly rather than in hot spots, reducing glare at eye level.
  • Smooth dimming: scale the output from full brightness for gatherings down to a soft glow for the evening.

Installation & Wiring Guide

Mounting Options

The 62-2404 mounts to a standard ceiling junction box rated to support the fixture's weight. Because the body weighs only 8.6 pounds, most code-compliant fixture boxes will handle it without a fan-rated brace — but always confirm your box's listed weight capacity before hanging. The included 9-foot supply wire gives you plenty of adjustment range: hang it low over a dining table (roughly 30–36 inches above the tabletop is the classic rule) or higher in a foyer, keeping at least 7 feet of clearance in walk-through areas. If your ceiling is sloped, verify canopy compatibility with the angle before installation.

Wiring & Safety Instructions

  • Turn off power at the breaker — not just the wall switch — and verify with a voltage tester before touching any conductors.
  • Connect fixture leads to the 120V supply: hot to hot (black), neutral to neutral (white), and ground to the ground conductor or grounding screw.
  • This fixture is rated for dry, indoor locations only. Do not install it in bathrooms above tubs, covered patios, or any damp-rated application.
  • The LED arrays are integrated and not user-serviceable; never open the driver housing.
  • All wiring must comply with the National Electrical Code (NEC) and local codes. When in doubt, hire a licensed electrician — especially for older homes without a grounded fixture box.

Certifications, Standards & DLC Listing

The Nuvo 62-2404 is cETLus listed for safety in both the United States and Canada and complies with RoHS and FCC requirements. As a decorative residential-class fixture, it is not DLC listed — DLC qualification applies to commercial and industrial luminaires eligible for utility rebates, not ornamental chandeliers. Satco backs the fixture with a 3-year limited warranty covering the integrated LED system and driver.

Compatible Accessories & Dimmers

Because the 62-2404 uses an integrated LED driver, pair it with an LED-compatible phase-cut dimmer rather than a legacy incandescent-only model — an incompatible dimmer can cause flicker or a limited dimming range. Browse our standard LED dimmers or step up to a smart wireless dimmer for app and voice control. Always check the dimmer manufacturer's LED compatibility list (Lutron publishes one for every model) before purchase, and confirm the dimmer's LED load rating covers the fixture's 85W draw.

  • Nuvo 62-2406 Kenzo LED Mini Pendant — for flanking the chandelier over counters or nooks
  • Nuvo 62-2407 Kenzo LED Wall Sconce — carries the edge-lit look onto hallway and stairwell walls
  • LED-rated dimmer switch — unlocks the fixture's full dimming range
  • Decorative wall plate — a finished look for the paired dimmer or switch

Product Overview

The Westgate ULR-OT-98F-HO-COB-50K is a COB LED tape light that delivers 3W per ft producing 290~340LM per ft at 2700K/3000K/3500K/4000K/5000K/6500K, suited to cove and under-cabinet lighting.

It carries a IP67 rating.

Key Features

  • Switchable color temperature (2700K/3000K/3500K/4000K/5000K/6500K) sets warm to cool light at install without changing fixtures.
  • IP67 rated, so it installs outdoors and in washdown or wet areas.
  • 24VDC (LED driver required) low-voltage operation for landscape and cabinet systems.
  • Dimmable for adjustable light levels.
  • 96~113LM/W per ft efficacy delivers high output per watt for energy-conscious projects.
  • 90 color rendering for accurate, true-to-life appearance.

column2: Infratech Bond Smart On/Off Switch with 2-Hour Timer (15-1725)
column3:
The Infratech 15-1725 Bond smart switch adds 120 V on/off control with Wi-Fi and voice operation to an Infratech outdoor heating system. It mounts in a standard wall box and also drives heaters remotely through the Bond app, with a built-in 2-hour auto-off timer.

Key Features
  • Switches heaters from the wall or remotely through the Bond app from anywhere over Wi-Fi
  • Works hands-free with Google Assistant, Amazon Alexa, Samsung SmartThings, and Control4
  • Built-in 2-hour auto-off timer shuts heaters off automatically to limit wasted energy
  • Zone control runs multiple heaters from a single switch
  • Pairs exclusively with Infratech Contactor Panels, which carry the heater load
Technical Specifications
Brand Infratech
Item Number 15-1725
Product Type Smart On/Off Switch
Series Bond
Voltage 120 V AC
Control Method Wall switch, Bond app, and voice
Timer Built-in 2-hour auto-off
Voice Platforms Google Assistant, Alexa, SmartThings, Control4
Compatibility Infratech Contactor Panels
Mounting Standard wall box
Weight 5 lbs
Applications

Common applications include:

  • Residential patios and outdoor living spaces with app and voice control
  • Restaurant and hospitality patios needing scheduled or remote heater control
  • Multi-heater zones managed from one wall location
Compatibility and Installation Notes

Operates on a 120 V circuit and pairs only with an Infratech Contactor Panel — it does not switch heater load directly. A Wi-Fi connection is required for app and voice features.

Lumera Electric supplies the Infratech 15-1725 Bond smart switch for adding app and voice control to contactor-panel-based heater installations.
